stage1_candidate_roster.metadata_rules: same GBIF 2026-08-01 / 2010-2025 Tracheophyta SPECIES / >=500 rows / >=20 occupied 1-degree cells / family+genus required / coordinate QC as v2
stage1_candidate_roster.breadth_before_roster: max one per genus, max four per family
stage1_candidate_roster.deterministic_order: new SHA-256 seed independent of v2

stage2_support_eligibility.purpose: technical support-mask eligibility before final taxon selection
stage2_support_eligibility.predictors: same frozen 42 CHELSA + four SoilGrids topsoil predictors
stage2_support_eligibility.source_decoding_rules: inherit six deterministic CHELSA structural-state decoding rules from terminal v2

stage3_final_cohort.breadth: max one per genus and max two per family
stage3_final_cohort.deterministic_order: second frozen SHA-256 seed distinct from stage1 candidate roster seed

failure_rules.fewer_than_50_support_eligible_taxa: terminal_unavailable; do not lower support gate or expand roster
failure_rules.breadth_constraints_cannot_fill_50: terminal_unavailable; do not relax genus/family caps
failure_rules.any_candidate_source_or_feature_failure: retain candidate as ineligible; no per-candidate repair after screen

next_gate_if_pass: freeze source identity, process registry, M, outer split and empirical EMP-A–EMP-F execution on the final 50 before sealed answer-check access
prohibited: reuse any of the 50 v2 taxa
select final taxa by outcome or model performance
rank final taxa by amount of SoilGrids coverage once the binary technical gate is passed
delete soil predictors to rescue taxa
open sealed answer-check before final cohort and execution contract are frozen
